name: Data Analyzer: UI sends the analysis request to the configured API address with the key
objective: Shows the UI calls the API address it is configured with and sends the key as a header.
precondition: Web-page component (the UI's data-analysis client) loaded in the offline test harness. The network call to the API is replaced by a canned reply, so no server and no AI model are used.

steps.action: Configure address 'http://data-analyzer-api.internal:8000' and key 'secret-key', then run an analysis.
steps.data: Made-up 10-row employee table (id, name, age, department, salary, hire_date, is_active) with a few deliberate errors.
steps.expected: The call goes to <address>/api/v1/analyze and its headers are exactly X-API-Key = secret-key.

name: Data Analyzer: UI defaults to the local address and sends no key when nothing is configured
objective: Shows the developer default (local machine, port 8000) is used and no key header is sent.
precondition: Web-page component (the UI's data-analysis client) loaded in the offline test harness. The network call to the API is replaced by a canned reply, so no server and no AI model are used. Address and key settings are removed.

steps.action: Run an analysis with no address or key configured.
steps.data: Made-up 10-row employee table (id, name, age, department, salary, hire_date, is_active) with a few deliberate errors.
steps.expected: The call goes to http://localhost:8000/api/v1/analyze and the headers are empty.

name: Data Analyzer: UI uploads the table as a CSV file named data.csv
objective: Shows the data is sent as a CSV file the API can read back intact.
precondition: Web-page component (the UI's data-analysis client) loaded in the offline test harness. The network call to the API is replaced by a canned reply, so no server and no AI model are used.

steps.action: Run an analysis and inspect the uploaded file.
steps.data: Made-up 10-row employee table (id, name, age, department, salary, hire_date, is_active) with a few deliberate errors.
steps.expected: File name is data.csv, type text/csv, and re-reading the content gives the same column names and row count.

name: Data Analyzer: UI sends the dictionary's schema and rules as JSON form fields
objective: Shows the expected column types and the validation rules reach the API unchanged.
precondition: Web-page component (the UI's data-analysis client) loaded in the offline test harness. The network call to the API is replaced by a canned reply, so no server and no AI model are used.

steps.action: Run an analysis with a made-up dictionary holding a schema and validation rules (age, salary, department).
steps.expected: The sent 'schema' field decodes to the same schema, and the 'rules' field to the same rules.

name: Data Analyzer: UI sends no schema or rules when no dictionary is loaded
objective: Shows the optional fields are left out when not available.
precondition: Web-page component (the UI's data-analysis client) loaded in the offline test harness. The network call to the API is replaced by a canned reply, so no server and no AI model are used.

steps.action: Run an analysis with no dictionary.
steps.data: Made-up 10-row employee table (id, name, age, department, salary, hire_date, is_active) with a few deliberate errors.
steps.expected: The form data contains neither 'schema' nor 'rules'.

name: Data Analyzer: UI re-sends an Excel upload as a real .xlsx file
objective: Shows files originally uploaded as Excel are sent as Excel so the API reads them with the Excel reader.
precondition: Web-page component (the UI's data-analysis client) loaded in the offline test harness. The network call to the API is replaced by a canned reply, so no server and no AI model are used.

steps.action: Run an analysis with source format 'xlsx'.
steps.data: Made-up 10-row employee table (id, name, age, department, salary, hire_date, is_active) with a few deliberate errors.
steps.expected: File name data.xlsx, content type 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet', and it reads back as Excel with the same columns and row count.

name: Data Analyzer: UI labels a legacy Excel upload as .xls
objective: Shows the older Excel format gets the matching file name and type. Only the name and type are checked, not the content.
precondition: Web-page component (the UI's data-analysis client) loaded in the offline test harness. The network call to the API is replaced by a canned reply, so no server and no AI model are used.

steps.action: Run an analysis with source format 'xls'.
steps.data: Made-up 10-row employee table (id, name, age, department, salary, hire_date, is_active) with a few deliberate errors.
steps.expected: File name data.xls and content type 'application/vnd.ms-excel'.

name: Data Analyzer: UI sends CSV when the original file format is not set
objective: Shows the default upload is CSV.
precondition: Web-page component (the UI's data-analysis client) loaded in the offline test harness. The network call to the API is replaced by a canned reply, so no server and no AI model are used.

steps.action: Run an analysis with source format none.
steps.data: Made-up 10-row employee table (id, name, age, department, salary, hire_date, is_active) with a few deliberate errors.
steps.expected: File name data.csv and content type text/csv.

name: Data Analyzer: UI result has the seven sections the dashboard needs
objective: Shows the analysis result handed to the dashboard has the agreed layout, including the rule-coverage section.
precondition: Web-page component (the UI's data-analysis client) loaded in the offline test harness. The network call to the API is replaced by a canned reply, so no server and no AI model are used.

steps.action: Run an analysis against a canned API reply.
steps.data: Canned reply with five sections (summary, issues, recommendations, quality_checks, summary_stats).
steps.expected: Result keys are exactly seven: summary, issues, recommendations, quality_checks, summary_stats, logic_validation_error and rule_coverage (the last two are added by the UI itself).

name: Data Analyzer: UI shows the API's row and column counts unchanged
objective: Shows the counts in the API reply reach the dashboard unchanged.
precondition: Web-page component (the UI's data-analysis client) loaded in the offline test harness. The network call to the API is replaced by a canned reply, so no server and no AI model are used.

steps.action: Run an analysis against a canned reply giving 10 rows and 7 columns.
steps.expected: summary total_rows and total_columns equal those counts.

name: Data Analyzer: UI shows the API's list of issues unchanged
objective: Shows issues are not altered, dropped or re-counted by the UI.
precondition: Web-page component (the UI's data-analysis client) loaded in the offline test harness. The network call to the API is replaced by a canned reply, so no server and no AI model are used.

steps.action: Run an analysis against a canned reply with two issues: a salary range error and a name missing-values warning.
steps.expected: The issues list is identical to what the API sent; issues_found is 2, critical_issues 1, warnings 1.

name: Data Analyzer: UI passes the detailed check results and statistics through unchanged
objective: Shows the detailed sections reach the dashboard unchanged.
precondition: Web-page component (the UI's data-analysis client) loaded in the offline test harness. The network call to the API is replaced by a canned reply, so no server and no AI model are used.

steps.action: Run an analysis against a canned reply with a row-count check and a shape statistic.
steps.expected: quality_checks and summary_stats equal what the API sent.

name: Data Analyzer: UI shows 'no issues' when the API reports none
objective: Shows a clean report is displayed as clean. The result comes from the canned reply, so this tests the UI's mapping only.
precondition: Web-page component (the UI's data-analysis client) loaded in the offline test harness. The network call to the API is replaced by a canned reply, so no server and no AI model are used.

steps.action: Run an analysis against a canned reply with no issues.
steps.expected: issues is empty, issues_found is 0 and completeness is 100.0.

steps.action: Run an analysis with a dictionary that has rules but no field list.
steps.data: Made-up 10-row employee table (id, name, age, department, salary, hire_date, is_active) with a few deliberate errors.

steps.expected: Result total_rows equals the file's row count and issues is a list.
